overview.description: The State Street Industrial Select Sector SPDR Premium Income ETF (XLII) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Industrial Select Sector index. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds offering exposure to the US industrials sector through holding of the Industrials Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLI). The fund aims for additional income by writing short-term listed call options on its equity options XLII was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
